title: The complete Shikaku archive
lede: Six archive rooms for fans who want to go deeper than a summary.
intro: This wiki is arranged like a filing cabinet: each drawer opens one side of the story. Start with the characters if the world is new to you, or go straight to the kanji if you came because the title made you curious.
Every page is available in Indonesian and English, uses the labels [FACT], [FAN ANALYSIS], [FAN THEORY], and [OPINION], and respects spoiler-safe mode.
